name: A payout from an Italian pension fund while living in Zurich
workings: An Italian pension fund is a tax-deferred wrapper to the Swiss system: no wealth tax on it, and a payout is taxed like a Swiss pension lump sum (treaty Art. 18; verify that Swiss practice treats it so), with a warning.
Zurich: 1/20 = 2,500 is below the tariff's zero band, so the 2% minimum: simple 1,000; cantonal 950, communal 1,190.
